ThingDef.label: Type 67-1 GPMG
ThingDef.description:
Caliber: 7.62x54mmR. 100-round bullet link. Select-Fire.
The Type 67 is a Chinese general purpose machine gun designed in the 1960s. Prior to the weapon's production, the Chinese military relied mostly on domestic production versions of the SG-43 Goryunov medium machine gun in the squad support role, with copies of the Soviet RPD, DPM, and RP46 being used for infantry roles - however, the former was too bulky and unwieldy, and the latter weapons did not adequately serve as general purpose machine guns. Soviet PK machine guns were unable to be acquired due to the ongoing Sino-Soviet tensions, and therefore, a domestic machine gun design was needed, the results of which produced the Type 67. Although having been superceded in PLA service by other machine guns, the Type 67 still exists in a limited capacity, and continues to be produced for export.
The Type 67-1 variant is a later update that changed the gun's furniture to polymer and moved the position of the bipod to a mount below the front sight post, making it easier to quick-detach.
